given: a stock record whose batch_number and serial_number are NULL because its original code had no batch or serial segment
when: the down path reconstructs its inventory_code
then: the inventory_code is reconstructed from the location alone without spurious hyphen delimiters or NULL text, and the row is not corrupted

independence.rationale: AC2 covers a fully-split row; this covers the distinct null-segment case whose reconstruction must not emit trailing delimiters or literal NULLs, and can be failed independently by producing 'A12--' while AC2's full-row join stays correct.

architectural_notes: Infra: the NULL-segment edge of the downgrade DML transform on stock_records, owned by the same migration revision. Ties to PI1-batch-serial-nullable: because batch_number/serial_number were added NULLABLE, the reconstruction must coalesce/conditionally-join so a NULL segment yields the location alone , never a naive concat producing trailing hyphens or literal 'NULL' text. This defends the no-corruption guarantee (R1); the delimiter-join logic stays in the migration, not the service. Verified by a real-branch test seeding a row with NULL batch and serial and asserting inventory_code equals the location with no spurious delimiters (R4).
